excerpt: What role can the browser play in the AI era?
content_html:
As AI becomes a greater and more important presence in our everyday lives, the way we interact with the "traditional" internet is changing.

For so long the main way to access the internet, the web browser is now having to rethink how to appeal to an audience which often seeks AI-first interaction - raising new challenges for developers to create the best and most interactive experience.

We spoke to Ajit Varma, Head of Firefox at Mozilla, to find out more.

  • The web has always been built on the principles of openness and interoperability, but today's internet is increasingly shaped by a handful of dominant platforms and AI-powered services. What does the 'open web' mean in 2026, and why does it still matter?

The open web matters more today than it has in years because AI is changing how people experience the internet. As a small number of platforms become the gateway to search, content and AI-powered services, it's becoming easier for a handful of companies to shape what people see and how they interact online.

That's why the principles of the open web still matter. Common standards mean developers can build without asking permission from a dominant platform, and users can choose how they access the web rather than being locked into a single ecosystem. Those principles have driven innovation for decades, and they're just as important as AI reshapes the internet.

The challenge now isn't simply keeping the web open as it exists today. It's making sure openness evolves alongside AI, so the next generation of the internet remains competitive, interoperable and accessible to everyone

  • AI is changing the way people discover information and interact with the internet. How do you see browsers evolving over the next five years, and what role should they play in helping users navigate an increasingly AI-driven web while maintaining trust and choice?

Over the next five years, you’ll start to see more divergences in how browsers treat AI. Many companies will use the browser to try and push a specific AI agenda but at Firefox we’re focused on how AI can make the tasks a user wants to do in a browser better. This includes things like a personal agent that can help a user accomplish tasks, navigating the web through voice, making the web more enjoyable, and creating new vibe-coded extensions and mini-apps.

We’ll do all this in a way that is user centric. The browser should adapt to the user, rather than the other way round. Some people will want AI integrated into their everyday browsing, while others will prefer to use it for specific tasks. Maintaining trust means supporting those preferences and letting people decide how much they use AI.

Users should be able to choose any model they want including open and local models. The important thing is preserving that flexibility, so people can browse, search and get things done in a way that feels natural to them.

  • Privacy has long been a core part of Mozilla's mission, but consumers also expect convenience and highly personalised online experiences. How do you strike the right balance between protecting users' privacy and delivering the features people now expect from modern web experiences?

For me, striking the right balance starts with recognising that every user has different expectations of their browser. While context can make online experiences more useful and personalised, people should be able to understand how their data is used and decide what they are comfortable sharing. By giving users meaningful control over the features they adopt, Firefox can deliver modern experiences while continuing to protect their privacy.

This has guided our phased approach to AI, beginning with practical features such as summarisation, translation, tab organisation and optional AI chat integrations. Before introducing more advanced AI experiences such as Smart Window, we launched AI Controls so people can manage individual features or switch them off altogether.

Firefox is also model-agnostic, so users can choose or switch providers, use local models, or opt out entirely. Even though only a small minority of users disable AI features, people regularly tell us they value knowing the controls are there. Privacy and convenience can coexist when people are able to set the terms of the experience.

  • There's growing concern that the future of the web could become fragmented between closed AI ecosystems, proprietary platforms and app-based experiences. What do you see as the biggest threats to the open web, and what gives you confidence that it can continue to thrive?

The biggest risk isn't AI itself, it's concentration. If the same companies control the AI models, the interface people use to access them and the browser they interact through, users lose visibility, choice and ultimately agency. That's a much bigger shift than simply moving from one technology generation to another.

What's encouraging is that the issue is becoming harder to ignore. Developers want open standards. Regulators are paying closer attention to competition. Users are asking tougher questions about transparency and control. The web has always evolved through periods of disruption, but it has remained resilient because it's built on interoperability rather than permission. AI can strengthen that model rather than replacing it with a handful of closed ecosystems. The future doesn't have to be a choice between innovation and openness. We should expect both.

  • Developers have always been central to Mozilla's community. As AI transforms software development and web creation, how do you think the relationship between developers, browsers and the open web will change over the coming years?

AI is making it dramatically easier to build software, which means we're going to see more developers – and more people who aren't traditional developers – creating for the web. That's a huge opportunity, but only if they can build on an open platform rather than for a handful of closed ecosystems.

That's why the browser becomes even more important. It's no longer just where websites are displayed – it's becoming the layer where people interact with AI to search, create, organise information and complete tasks. As that layer becomes more powerful, it has to remain open, interoperable and centred around user choice.

For developers, that means being able to build for the web, rather than for whichever company happens to control the dominant model or platform. That's always been one of the web's greatest strengths, and it's something we shouldn't lose as AI reshapes how software is built and experienced.

  • If you look ahead to the end of this decade, what do you hope people will say about the state of the web? What would success look like for Mozilla's vision of an open, healthy internet?

Success, for me, is a web that's become more useful through AI without becoming less open. Technology should expand what's possible, not narrow the ways people can access information, build new ideas or participate online.

Innovation should continue to come from everywhere, not just a handful of dominant platforms. The web has always been at its best when anyone with a good idea can build something that reaches millions of people. That only happens when developers have open standards to build on and users aren't locked into a single ecosystem.

The web should still be the best place to build, discover and innovate because it remains accessible to everyone. If AI has expanded participation rather than concentrated power, we'll be heading in the right direction.

  • Mozilla is competing in a browser market dominated by much larger technology companies. How do you differentiate Firefox, and why do you believe there's still a commercial and societal case for an independent browser?

We differentiate through independence, choice and accountability. Most browsers are tied to larger technology ecosystems spanning across multiple systems, search, advertising and AI.

Instead, Firefox is powered by Gecko, the only remaining independent browser engine, which gives us the freedom to make product decisions around what benefits users. It ensures that Mozilla is not only advocating for these principles but actively building the underlying infrastructure that makes them possible.

That independence is commercially relevant because there’s such a clear demand for genuine choice. Firefox has been selected through EU browser choice screens more than six million times in two years and those users are five times more likely to remain with Firefox than people who find it organically.

Societally, independent engines prevent one company’s technical and commercial priorities from being the default for the entire web. They also preserve competition, interoperability and the ability to build around different values.

  • As regulators around the world seek to promote competition in digital markets, are we at a turning point for the open web, or is there still a risk that power becomes even more concentrated through AI?

There are certainly some encouraging signs that regulation can restore meaningful choice. The impact of browser choice screens in Europe shows that people choose alternatives when they are presented fairly and without being steered towards a default.

However, AI is creating a new concentration risk. If the same small group of companies control the operating system, browser, search engine and AI model, it becomes much easier for them to shape how people access information and which services they encounter.

Regulation needs to keep pace not only with how AI is developed, but with how it's distributed and embedded into everyday products. However, regulation can't do this alone. Interoperability, genuine defaults and strong technical competition will matter just as much.

  • Trust has become a key differentiator in technology. How can browser makers earn and maintain users' trust as AI assistants become embedded in everyday web browsing?

Trust starts with being clear about what the technology is doing. AI should be optional, transparent and designed so users can understand what information it can access, how it’s being used and who is acting on their behalf.

That’s the principle behind Firefox’s AI controls. AI features are optional and can be managed individually, while a single setting allows users to block current and future generative AI features. We also use on-device models for features such as Link Previews and Smart Tab Groups, allowing people to receive AI assistance without any data leaving their device.

Ultimately, trust isn't earned through a single feature. It's earned by being transparent about how AI works and consistently respecting the decisions people make.

sentences.en: This has guided our phased approach to AI, beginning with practical features such as summarisation, translation, tab organisation and optional AI chat integrations.
sentences.zh: 这指导了我们分阶段的人工智能方法，从总结、翻译、选项卡组织和可选的人工智能聊天集成等实用功能开始。

sentences.en: Before introducing more advanced AI experiences such as Smart Window, we launched AI Controls so people can manage individual features or switch them off altogether.
sentences.zh: 在引入智能窗口等更先进的人工智能体验之前，我们推出了人工智能控制，以便人们可以管理个别功能或完全关闭它们。

blocks.html_en: Firefox is also model-agnostic, so users can choose or switch providers, use local models, or opt out entirely. Even though only a small minority of users disable AI features, people regularly tell us they value knowing the controls are there. Privacy and convenience can coexist when people are able to set the terms of the experience.

sentences.en: Firefox is also model-agnostic, so users can choose or switch providers, use local models, or opt out entirely.
sentences.zh: Firefox 与模型无关，因此用户可以选择或切换提供商、使用本地模型或完全退出。

sentences.en: Even though only a small minority of users disable AI features, people regularly tell us they value knowing the controls are there.
sentences.zh: 尽管只有一小部分用户禁用人工智能功能，但人们经常告诉我们，他们很重视了解这些控件的存在。

sentences.en: Privacy and convenience can coexist when people are able to set the terms of the experience.
sentences.zh: 当人们能够设定体验条款时，隐私和便利就可以共存。

blocks.html_en: • There's growing concern that the future of the web could become fragmented between closed AI ecosystems, proprietary platforms and app-based experiences. What do you see as the biggest threats to the open web, and what gives you confidence that it can continue to thrive?

sentences.en: There's growing concern that the future of the web could become fragmented between closed AI ecosystems, proprietary platforms and app-based experiences.
sentences.zh: 人们越来越担心网络的未来可能会在封闭的人工智能生态系统、专有平台和基于应用程序的体验之间变得支离破碎。

sentences.en: What do you see as the biggest threats to the open web, and what gives you confidence that it can continue to thrive?
sentences.zh: 您认为开放网络面临的最大威胁是什么？是什么让您相信开放网络能够继续蓬勃发展？

blocks.html_en: The biggest risk isn't AI itself, it's concentration. If the same companies control the AI models, the interface people use to access them and the browser they interact through, users lose visibility, choice and ultimately agency. That's a much bigger shift than simply moving from one technology generation to another.

sentences.en: The biggest risk isn't AI itself, it's concentration.
sentences.zh: 最大的风险不是人工智能本身，而是集中度。

sentences.en: If the same companies control the AI models, the interface people use to access them and the browser they interact through, users lose visibility, choice and ultimately agency.
sentences.zh: 如果同一家公司控制人工智能模型、人们用来访问它们的界面以及他们交互的浏览器，那么用户就会失去可见性、选择权并最终失去代理权。

sentences.en: That's a much bigger shift than simply moving from one technology generation to another.
sentences.zh: 这是一个比简单地从一代技术转向另一代技术更大的转变。

blocks.html_en: What's encouraging is that the issue is becoming harder to ignore. Developers want open standards. Regulators are paying closer attention to competition. Users are asking tougher questions about transparency and control. The web has always evolved through periods of disruption, but it has remained resilient because it's built on interoperability rather than permission. AI can strengthen that model rather than replacing it with a handful of closed ecosystems. The future doesn't have to be a choice between innovation and openness. We should expect both.

sentences.en: What's encouraging is that the issue is becoming harder to ignore.
sentences.zh: 令人鼓舞的是，这个问题正变得越来越难以忽视。

sentences.en: Developers want open standards.
sentences.zh: 开发人员需要开放标准。

sentences.en: Regulators are paying closer attention to competition.
sentences.zh: 监管机构正在更加关注竞争。

sentences.en: Users are asking tougher questions about transparency and control.
sentences.zh: 用户正在询问有关透明度和控制的更棘手的问题。

sentences.en: The web has always evolved through periods of disruption, but it has remained resilient because it's built on interoperability rather than permission.
sentences.zh: 网络总是在颠覆时期不断发展，但它仍然保持弹性，因为它是建立在互操作性而不是许可的基础上的。

sentences.en: AI can strengthen that model rather than replacing it with a handful of closed ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 人工智能可以加强该模型，而不是用少数封闭的生态系统取代它。

sentences.en: The future doesn't have to be a choice between innovation and openness.
sentences.zh: 未来不一定是创新和开放之间的选择。

sentences.en: We should expect both.
sentences.zh: 我们应该期待两者。

blocks.html_en: • Developers have always been central to Mozilla's community. As AI transforms software development and web creation, how do you think the relationship between developers, browsers and the open web will change over the coming years?

sentences.en: Developers have always been central to Mozilla's community.
sentences.zh: 开发人员一直是 Mozilla 社区的核心。

sentences.en: As AI transforms software development and web creation, how do you think the relationship between developers, browsers and the open web will change over the coming years?
sentences.zh: 随着人工智能改变软件开发和网络创建，您认为未来几年开发人员、浏览器和开放网络之间的关系将如何变化？

blocks.html_en: AI is making it dramatically easier to build software, which means we're going to see more developers – and more people who aren't traditional developers – creating for the web. That's a huge opportunity, but only if they can build on an open platform rather than for a handful of closed ecosystems.

sentences.en: AI is making it dramatically easier to build software, which means we're going to see more developers – and more people who aren't traditional developers – creating for the web.
sentences.zh: 人工智能使构建软件变得更加容易，这意味着我们将看到更多的开发人员（以及更多非传统开发人员）为网络进行创作。

sentences.en: That's a huge opportunity, but only if they can build on an open platform rather than for a handful of closed ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的机会，但前提是他们能够在开放平台上构建，而不是在少数封闭的生态系统上构建。

blocks.html_en: That's why the browser becomes even more important. It's no longer just where websites are displayed – it's becoming the layer where people interact with AI to search, create, organise information and complete tasks. As that layer becomes more powerful, it has to remain open, interoperable and centred around user choice.

sentences.en: That's why the browser becomes even more important.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么浏览器变得更加重要。

sentences.en: It's no longer just where websites are displayed – it's becoming the layer where people interact with AI to search, create, organise information and complete tasks.
sentences.zh: 它不再只是显示网站的地方，它正在成为人们与人工智能交互以搜索、创建、组织信息和完成任务的层。

sentences.en: As that layer becomes more powerful, it has to remain open, interoperable and centred around user choice.
sentences.zh: 随着该层变得更加强大，它必须保持开放、可互操作并以用户选择为中心。

blocks.html_en: For developers, that means being able to build for the web, rather than for whichever company happens to control the dominant model or platform. That's always been one of the web's greatest strengths, and it's something we shouldn't lose as AI reshapes how software is built and experienced.

sentences.en: For developers, that means being able to build for the web, rather than for whichever company happens to control the dominant model or platform.
sentences.zh: 对于开发人员来说，这意味着能够为网络进行构建，而不是为恰好控制主导模型或平台的任何公司进行构建。

sentences.en: That's always been one of the web's greatest strengths, and it's something we shouldn't lose as AI reshapes how software is built and experienced.
sentences.zh: 这一直是网络最大的优势之一，随着人工智能重塑软件的构建和体验方式，我们不应该失去这一点。

sentences.en: (Image credit: Mozilla)
sentences.zh: （图片来源：Mozilla）

blocks.html_en: • If you look ahead to the end of this decade, what do you hope people will say about the state of the web? What would success look like for Mozilla's vision of an open, healthy internet?

sentences.en: If you look ahead to the end of this decade, what do you hope people will say about the state of the web?
sentences.zh: 如果您展望本十年末，您希望人们对网络现状有何看法？

sentences.en: What would success look like for Mozilla's vision of an open, healthy internet?
sentences.zh: Mozilla 开放、健康的互联网愿景如何才能取得成功？

blocks.html_en: Success, for me, is a web that's become more useful through AI without becoming less open. Technology should expand what's possible, not narrow the ways people can access information, build new ideas or participate online.

sentences.en: Success, for me, is a web that's become more useful through AI without becoming less open.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，成功是一个通过人工智能变得更加有用而又不变得不那么开放的网络。

sentences.en: Technology should expand what's possible, not narrow the ways people can access information, build new ideas or participate online.
sentences.zh: 技术应该扩大可能性，而不是缩小人们获取信息、提出新想法或在线参与的方式。

blocks.html_en: Innovation should continue to come from everywhere, not just a handful of dominant platforms. The web has always been at its best when anyone with a good idea can build something that reaches millions of people. That only happens when developers have open standards to build on and users aren't locked into a single ecosystem.

sentences.en: Innovation should continue to come from everywhere, not just a handful of dominant platforms.
sentences.zh: 创新应该继续来自各地，而不仅仅是少数占主导地位的平台。

sentences.en: The web has always been at its best when anyone with a good idea can build something that reaches millions of people.
sentences.zh: 当任何有好主意的人都可以构建出覆盖数百万人的东西时，网络就始终处于最佳状态。

sentences.en: That only happens when developers have open standards to build on and users aren't locked into a single ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 只有当开发人员拥有可供构建的开放标准并且用户不被锁定在单一生态系统中时，这种情况才会发生。

blocks.html_en: The web should still be the best place to build, discover and innovate because it remains accessible to everyone. If AI has expanded participation rather than concentrated power, we'll be heading in the right direction.

sentences.en: The web should still be the best place to build, discover and innovate because it remains accessible to everyone.
sentences.zh: 网络仍然应该是构建、发现和创新的最佳场所，因为每个人都可以访问它。

sentences.en: If AI has expanded participation rather than concentrated power, we'll be heading in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 如果人工智能扩大了参与而不是集中了力量，我们就会朝着正确的方向前进。

blocks.html_en: • Mozilla is competing in a browser market dominated by much larger technology companies. How do you differentiate Firefox, and why do you believe there's still a commercial and societal case for an independent browser?

sentences.en: Mozilla is competing in a browser market dominated by much larger technology companies.
sentences.zh: Mozilla 正在竞争由规模大得多的科技公司主导的浏览器市场。

sentences.en: How do you differentiate Firefox, and why do you believe there's still a commercial and societal case for an independent browser?
sentences.zh: 您如何区分 Firefox？为什么您认为独立浏览器仍然有商业和社会价值？

blocks.html_en: We differentiate through independence, choice and accountability. Most browsers are tied to larger technology ecosystems spanning across multiple systems, search, advertising and AI.

sentences.en: We differentiate through independence, choice and accountability.
sentences.zh: 我们通过独立、选择和责任来脱颖而出。

sentences.en: Most browsers are tied to larger technology ecosystems spanning across multiple systems, search, advertising and AI.
sentences.zh: 大多数浏览器都与跨越多个系统、搜索、广告和人工智能的更大的技术生态系统联系在一起。

blocks.html_en: Instead, Firefox is powered by Gecko, the only remaining independent browser engine, which gives us the freedom to make product decisions around what benefits users. It ensures that Mozilla is not only advocating for these principles but actively building the underlying infrastructure that makes them possible.

sentences.en: Instead, Firefox is powered by Gecko, the only remaining independent browser engine, which gives us the freedom to make product decisions around what benefits users.
sentences.zh: 相反，Firefox 由 Gecko 提供支持，这是唯一剩下的独立浏览器引擎，这使我们可以自由地围绕用户的利益做出产品决策。

sentences.en: It ensures that Mozilla is not only advocating for these principles but actively building the underlying infrastructure that makes them possible.
sentences.zh: 它确保 Mozilla 不仅倡导这些原则，而且积极构建使这些原则成为可能的底层基础设施。

blocks.html_en: That independence is commercially relevant because there’s such a clear demand for genuine choice. Firefox has been selected through EU browser choice screens more than six million times in two years and those users are five times more likely to remain with Firefox than people who find it organically.

sentences.en: That independence is commercially relevant because there’s such a clear demand for genuine choice.
sentences.zh: 这种独立性具有商业意义，因为对真正选择的需求如此明确。

sentences.en: Firefox has been selected through EU browser choice screens more than six million times in two years and those users are five times more likely to remain with Firefox than people who find it organically.
sentences.zh: 两年内，Firefox 通过欧盟浏览器选择屏幕被选择的次数超过 600 万次，这些用户继续使用 Firefox 的可能性是自然找到它的用户的五倍。

blocks.html_en: Societally, independent engines prevent one company’s technical and commercial priorities from being the default for the entire web. They also preserve competition, interoperability and the ability to build around different values.

sentences.en: Societally, independent engines prevent one company’s technical and commercial priorities from being the default for the entire web.
sentences.zh: 在社会上，独立的引擎会阻止一家公司的技术和商业优先事项成为整个网络的默认优先事项。

sentences.en: They also preserve competition, interoperability and the ability to build around different values.
sentences.zh: 它们还保留竞争、互操作性以及围绕不同价值观构建的能力。

blocks.html_en: • As regulators around the world seek to promote competition in digital markets, are we at a turning point for the open web, or is there still a risk that power becomes even more concentrated through AI?

sentences.en: As regulators around the world seek to promote competition in digital markets, are we at a turning point for the open web, or is there still a risk that power becomes even more concentrated through AI?
sentences.zh: 随着世界各地的监管机构寻求促进数字市场的竞争，我们是否正处于开放网络的转折点，或者是否仍然存在权力通过人工智能变得更加集中的风险？

blocks.html_en: There are certainly some encouraging signs that regulation can restore meaningful choice. The impact of browser choice screens in Europe shows that people choose alternatives when they are presented fairly and without being steered towards a default.

sentences.en: There are certainly some encouraging signs that regulation can restore meaningful choice.
sentences.zh: 当然有一些令人鼓舞的迹象表明监管可以恢复有意义的选择。

sentences.en: The impact of browser choice screens in Europe shows that people choose alternatives when they are presented fairly and without being steered towards a default.
sentences.zh: 欧洲浏览器选择屏幕的影响表明，人们会在公平呈现的情况下选择替代方案，而不是被引导至默认选项。

blocks.html_en: However, AI is creating a new concentration risk. If the same small group of companies control the operating system, browser, search engine and AI model, it becomes much easier for them to shape how people access information and which services they encounter.

sentences.en: However, AI is creating a new concentration risk.
sentences.zh: 然而，人工智能正在带来新的集中风险。

sentences.en: If the same small group of companies control the operating system, browser, search engine and AI model, it becomes much easier for them to shape how people access information and which services they encounter.
sentences.zh: 如果同一小群公司控制操作系统、浏览器、搜索引擎和人工智能模型，那么他们就更容易决定人们访问信息的方式以及他们遇到的服务。

blocks.html_en: Regulation needs to keep pace not only with how AI is developed, but with how it's distributed and embedded into everyday products. However, regulation can't do this alone. Interoperability, genuine defaults and strong technical competition will matter just as much.

sentences.en: Regulation needs to keep pace not only with how AI is developed, but with how it's distributed and embedded into everyday products.
sentences.zh: 监管不仅需要跟上人工智能的开发方式，还需要跟上人工智能的分布和嵌入到日常产品中的方式。

sentences.en: However, regulation can't do this alone.
sentences.zh: 然而，单靠监管并不能做到这一点。

sentences.en: Interoperability, genuine defaults and strong technical competition will matter just as much.
sentences.zh: 互操作性、真正的默认设置和强大的技术竞争也同样重要。

blocks.html_en: • Trust has become a key differentiator in technology. How can browser makers earn and maintain users' trust as AI assistants become embedded in everyday web browsing?

sentences.en: Trust has become a key differentiator in technology.
sentences.zh: 信任已成为技术的关键差异化因素。

sentences.en: How can browser makers earn and maintain users' trust as AI assistants become embedded in everyday web browsing?
sentences.zh: 随着人工智能助手融入日常网页浏览，浏览器制造商如何赢得并维持用户的信任？

blocks.html_en: Trust starts with being clear about what the technology is doing. AI should be optional, transparent and designed so users can understand what information it can access, how it’s being used and who is acting on their behalf.

sentences.en: Trust starts with being clear about what the technology is doing.
sentences.zh: 信任始于清楚技术正在做什么。

sentences.en: AI should be optional, transparent and designed so users can understand what information it can access, how it’s being used and who is acting on their behalf.
sentences.zh: 人工智能应该是可选的、透明的，并且经过精心设计，以便用户能够了解它可以访问哪些信息、如何使用这些信息以及谁在代表他们行事。

blocks.html_en: That’s the principle behind Firefox’s AI controls. AI features are optional and can be managed individually, while a single setting allows users to block current and future generative AI features. We also use on-device models for features such as Link Previews and Smart Tab Groups, allowing people to receive AI assistance without any data leaving their device.

sentences.en: That’s the principle behind Firefox’s AI controls.
sentences.zh: 这就是 Firefox 人工智能控制背后的原理。

sentences.en: AI features are optional and can be managed individually, while a single setting allows users to block current and future generative AI features.
sentences.zh: AI 功能是可选的，可以单独管理，而单个设置允许用户阻止当前和未来的生成 AI 功能。

sentences.en: We also use on-device models for features such as Link Previews and Smart Tab Groups, allowing people to receive AI assistance without any data leaving their device.
sentences.zh: 我们还使用设备上的模型来实现链接预览和智能选项卡组等功能，使人们无需离开设备即可获得人工智能帮助。

blocks.html_en: Ultimately, trust isn't earned through a single feature. It's earned by being transparent about how AI works and consistently respecting the decisions people make.

sentences.en: Ultimately, trust isn't earned through a single feature.
sentences.zh: 最终，信任不是通过单一功能赢得的。

sentences.en: It's earned by being transparent about how AI works and consistently respecting the decisions people make.
sentences.zh: 它是通过对人工智能的工作原理保持透明并始终尊重人们做出的决定而获得的。

content_html_zh:
随着人工智能在我们的日常生活中变得越来越重要，我们与“传统”互联网互动的方式正在发生变化。

长期以来，网络浏览器一直是访问互联网的主要方式，现在不得不重新思考如何吸引经常寻求人工智能优先交互的受众——这为开发人员创造最佳、最具互动性的体验提出了新的挑战。

我们采访了 Mozilla Firefox 负责人 Ajit Varma，以了解更多信息。

  • 网络始终建立在开放性和互操作性的原则之上，但当今的互联网日益受到少数主导平台和人工智能驱动的服务的影响。 2026 年“开放网络”意味着什么？为什么它仍然很重要？

如今，开放网络比多年来更加重要，因为人工智能正在改变人们体验互联网的方式。 随着少数平台成为搜索、内容和人工智能服务的门户，少数公司可以更轻松地塑造人们所看到的内容以及他们在线互动的方式。

这就是为什么开放网络的原则仍然很重要。 通用标准意味着开发人员可以在不征求主导平台许可的情况下进行构建，用户可以选择访问网络的方式，而不是被锁定在单一生态系统中。 这些原则几十年来一直推动着创新，它们与人工智能重塑互联网一样重要。

现在的挑战不仅仅是保持当今的网络开放。 它确保开放性与人工智能一起发展，因此下一代互联网仍然具有竞争力、可互操作性并且可供每个人使用

  • 人工智能正在改变人们发现信息和与互联网交互的方式。 您如何看待未来五年浏览器的发展？它们在帮助用户浏览日益由人工智能驱动的网络同时保持信任和选择方面应发挥什么作用？

在接下来的五年中，您将开始看到浏览器对待人工智能的方式出现更多分歧。 许多公司会使用浏览器来尝试推动特定的人工智能议程，但在 Firefox，我们专注于人工智能如何更好地完成用户想要在浏览器中完成的任务。 这包括诸如个人代理之类的东西，可以帮助用户完成任务，通过语音导航网络，使网络更有趣，以及创建新的振动编码扩展和迷你应用程序。

我们将以以用户为中心的方式完成这一切。 浏览器应该适应用户，而不是相反。 有些人希望将人工智能集成到他们的日常浏览中，而另一些人则更喜欢将其用于特定任务。 维持信任意味着支持这些偏好并让人们决定他们使用人工智能的程度。

用户应该能够选择他们想要的任何模型，包括开放模型和本地模型。 重要的是保持这种灵活性，这样人们就可以以他们觉得自然的方式浏览、搜索和完成工作。

  • 长期以来，隐私一直是 Mozilla 使命的核心部分，但消费者也期望便利和高度个性化的在线体验。 如何在保护用户隐私和提供人们现在期望从现代网络体验中获得的功能之间取得适当的平衡？

对我来说，要实现正确的平衡，首先要认识到每个用户对浏览器都有不同的期望。 虽然上下文可以使在线体验更加有用和个性化，但人们应该能够了解他们的数据是如何使用的，并决定他们愿意分享哪些内容。 通过让用户对其所采用的功能进行有意义的控制，Firefox 可以提供现代体验，同时继续保护他们的隐私。

这指导了我们分阶段的人工智能方法，从总结、翻译、选项卡组织和可选的人工智能聊天集成等实用功能开始。 在引入智能窗口等更先进的人工智能体验之前，我们推出了人工智能控制，以便人们可以管理个别功能或完全关闭它们。

Firefox 与模型无关，因此用户可以选择或切换提供商、使用本地模型或完全退出。 尽管只有一小部分用户禁用人工智能功能，但人们经常告诉我们，他们很重视了解这些控件的存在。 当人们能够设定体验条款时，隐私和便利就可以共存。

  • 人们越来越担心网络的未来可能会在封闭的人工智能生态系统、专有平台和基于应用程序的体验之间变得支离破碎。 您认为开放网络面临的最大威胁是什么？是什么让您相信开放网络能够继续蓬勃发展？

最大的风险不是人工智能本身，而是集中度。 如果同一家公司控制人工智能模型、人们用来访问它们的界面以及他们交互的浏览器，那么用户就会失去可见性、选择权并最终失去代理权。 这是一个比简单地从一代技术转向另一代技术更大的转变。

令人鼓舞的是，这个问题正变得越来越难以忽视。 开发人员需要开放标准。 监管机构正在更加关注竞争。 用户正在询问有关透明度和控制的更棘手的问题。 网络总是在颠覆时期不断发展，但它仍然保持弹性，因为它是建立在互操作性而不是许可的基础上的。 人工智能可以加强该模型，而不是用少数封闭的生态系统取代它。 未来不一定是创新和开放之间的选择。 我们应该期待两者。

  • 开发人员一直是 Mozilla 社区的核心。 随着人工智能改变软件开发和网络创建，您认为未来几年开发人员、浏览器和开放网络之间的关系将如何变化？

人工智能使构建软件变得更加容易，这意味着我们将看到更多的开发人员（以及更多非传统开发人员）为网络进行创作。 这是一个巨大的机会，但前提是他们能够在开放平台上构建，而不是在少数封闭的生态系统上构建。

这就是为什么浏览器变得更加重要。 它不再只是显示网站的地方，它正在成为人们与人工智能交互以搜索、创建、组织信息和完成任务的层。 随着该层变得更加强大，它必须保持开放、可互操作并以用户选择为中心。

对于开发人员来说，这意味着能够为网络进行构建，而不是为恰好控制主导模型或平台的任何公司进行构建。 这一直是网络最大的优势之一，随着人工智能重塑软件的构建和体验方式，我们不应该失去这一点。

  • 如果您展望本十年末，您希望人们对网络现状有何看法？ Mozilla 开放、健康的互联网愿景如何才能取得成功？

对我来说，成功是一个通过人工智能变得更加有用而又不变得不那么开放的网络。 技术应该扩大可能性，而不是缩小人们获取信息、提出新想法或在线参与的方式。

创新应该继续来自各地，而不仅仅是少数占主导地位的平台。 当任何有好主意的人都可以构建出覆盖数百万人的东西时，网络就始终处于最佳状态。 只有当开发人员拥有可供构建的开放标准并且用户不被锁定在单一生态系统中时，这种情况才会发生。

网络仍然应该是构建、发现和创新的最佳场所，因为每个人都可以访问它。 如果人工智能扩大了参与而不是集中了力量，我们就会朝着正确的方向前进。

  • Mozilla 正在竞争由规模大得多的科技公司主导的浏览器市场。 您如何区分 Firefox？为什么您认为独立浏览器仍然有商业和社会价值？

我们通过独立、选择和责任来脱颖而出。 大多数浏览器都与跨越多个系统、搜索、广告和人工智能的更大的技术生态系统联系在一起。

相反，Firefox 由 Gecko 提供支持，这是唯一剩下的独立浏览器引擎，这使我们可以自由地围绕用户的利益做出产品决策。 它确保 Mozilla 不仅倡导这些原则，而且积极构建使这些原则成为可能的底层基础设施。

这种独立性具有商业意义，因为对真正选择的需求如此明确。 两年内，Firefox 通过欧盟浏览器选择屏幕被选择的次数超过 600 万次，这些用户继续使用 Firefox 的可能性是自然找到它的用户的五倍。

在社会上，独立的引擎会阻止一家公司的技术和商业优先事项成为整个网络的默认优先事项。 它们还保留竞争、互操作性以及围绕不同价值观构建的能力。

  • 随着世界各地的监管机构寻求促进数字市场的竞争，我们是否正处于开放网络的转折点，或者是否仍然存在权力通过人工智能变得更加集中的风险？

当然有一些令人鼓舞的迹象表明监管可以恢复有意义的选择。 欧洲浏览器选择屏幕的影响表明，人们会在公平呈现的情况下选择替代方案，而不是被引导至默认选项。

然而，人工智能正在带来新的集中风险。 如果同一小群公司控制操作系统、浏览器、搜索引擎和人工智能模型，那么他们就更容易决定人们访问信息的方式以及他们遇到的服务。

监管不仅需要跟上人工智能的开发方式，还需要跟上人工智能的分布和嵌入到日常产品中的方式。 然而，单靠监管并不能做到这一点。 互操作性、真正的默认设置和强大的技术竞争也同样重要。

  • 信任已成为技术的关键差异化因素。 随着人工智能助手融入日常网页浏览，浏览器制造商如何赢得并维持用户的信任？

信任始于清楚技术正在做什么。 人工智能应该是可选的、透明的，并且经过精心设计，以便用户能够了解它可以访问哪些信息、如何使用这些信息以及谁在代表他们行事。

这就是 Firefox 人工智能控制背后的原理。 AI 功能是可选的，可以单独管理，而单个设置允许用户阻止当前和未来的生成 AI 功能。 我们还使用设备上的模型来实现链接预览和智能选项卡组等功能，使人们无需离开设备即可获得人工智能帮助。

最终，信任不是通过单一功能赢得的。 它是通过对人工智能的工作原理保持透明并始终尊重人们做出的决定而获得的。
